summary.headline: Taurus Birth Prognoses
summary.text: Astrological birth prognoses for a younger man and a girl born under Taurus, detailing appearance, character, relationships, illnesses, lifespan, marks, remedies, religious protections, and marriage and children. The apparatus records manuscript readings and editorial emendations, with references to Saint Thekla, the Archistrategos, Dieterich, and Kroll.
